result.what_interviewer_wanted: Explain what overfitting is, how to detect it, and list practical prevention techniques, ideally with a project example.
result.improved_answer: Overfitting happens when a model captures noise instead of the underlying pattern, so training accuracy is high but validation accuracy drops. I detect it by looking for a gap between training and validation curves. To prevent it I use more data or augmentation, choose a simpler model, apply regularization (L1/L2 or dropout), employ early stopping, and validate with cross‑validation. In my crop‑disease CNN project, I saw a 99% training vs 80% validation accuracy, so I added data augmentation and early stopping, which raised test accuracy to 91%.
